checks.name: native_e2e_proof_gate_rejects_a_declared_negative_case
checks.run:
import json, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from factoryline.e2e_proof import verify_e2e_proof
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as raw:
    root = Path(raw)
    manifest = {"schema": "factory.e2e_proof_manifest.v1", "id": "smoke-e2e", "approval": {"state": "approved", "approved_by": "smoke-owner"}, "working_directory": ".", "timeout_seconds": 10, "network_egress": "not_granted", "positive": {"argv": [sys.executable, "-c", "from pathlib import Path; Path('artifact.txt').write_text('ok')"]}, "negative": {"argv": [sys.executable, "-c", "import sys; sys.exit(1)"]}, "artifact_paths": ["artifact.txt"]}
    path = root / "e2e.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest), encoding="utf-8")
    receipt = verify_e2e_proof(root, path)
    assert receipt["marker"] == "E2E_PROOF_PASS"
    assert receipt["commands"]["negative"]["exit_code"] == 1
print("E2E_PROOF_PASS")
